basis.quote: effective for the fiscal year ending June 30, 1924

proposed_intervals.end_basis: own terms: rates announced effective for fiscal year ending June 30, 1924

material_gaps: Original page images (ProQuest PDF PT1-1923-EO-3865.pdf) not inspected; text is an OCR layer. Ending rests on own terms, not on a later instrument.
rationale: EO 3865 (13 June 1923, Harding, text says No. 3865) announces the statutory rental and subsistence allowance rates 'as effective for the fiscal year ending June 30, 1924'. The order is time-limited by its own words; the fiscal year ended 30 June 1924, so nothing remained operative on 2026-10-14. Earlier endings: none held, none needed. Savings: none in text. The 1922 Act it implements is not itself held, but status rests only on the own-terms end.
